dependency: Based on PR7; diagnostic image only. No changes to shipping game chunks when OFF.
protocol: DERBY_TLM v=1; maximum one attempted line per device second, 300 attempts per run, no retry
storage: Fixed C state and 768-byte stack serialization buffer; numeric arguments to an existing native function. No new per-frame guest arrays/objects/functions. Additional diagnostic bytecode/argument stack changes the baseline footprint.
arming: Generated play chunk arms context only after procedural paint and HUD update return normally. New guest frame disarms first. Parked/incomplete work, failed presentation, duplicate transfer and incomplete native procedural work cannot count. Late completion may omit a frame rather than falsely bind it.

fields.run: Owner-task session serial, reset at app_stop; combine with broker epoch and build receipt
fields.us/begin: Monotonic device microseconds at completed banded presentation / first sampled presentation
fields.frame: Count of sampled successfully presented distinct completed guest contexts; not total renderer frames or LCD frames
fields.ctx: Fresh guest dispatch sequence; gaps disclose incomplete or unsampled contexts
fields.seed/race/phase: Game-reported field seed, race number, phase 0 pad/1 gate/2 race/3 photo/4 res
fields.cam/tier: Game camera ID (7/8/9 panning WIDE variants), load tier 0/1/2; pad/result mapped to CLOSE and photo to PHOTO
fields.step: Rounded rs.t/DT simulation step; does not encode all lane/camera history
fields.u: Interpolation in millionths for gate/race; -1 otherwise, including frozen photo
fields.gu_sample_max/cap: Maximum guest malloc counter observed at sampled presentations and current cap; LOWER BOUND on true peak
fields.eval_used/eval_cap: One checkpoint after entry evaluation returns; cap-used is checkpoint headroom, NOT minimum free evaluation margin; zeros mean unavailable
fields.intervals: Ten cumulative adjacent same-race/phase/camera/tier completed-context interval counts and device microseconds; skipped contexts/camera changes do not bridge
fields.seq/limit: Attempted output sequence / fixed 300-attempt ceiling; no final partial-window flush
fields.refused/io_us_max: Prior attempted writes refused / maximum prior write duration. Current output becomes visible only in a later record. Final write outcome is not known from that final line.

throughput: Diagnostic completed-context throughput only. Sink can block up to usb_console_frame timeout (about 100 ms plus tick rounding). No subtraction or extrapolation to ordinary firmware. Reject gaps, refusals, camera transitions and incomplete windows for thresholds; no data is unverified, not zero.
not_verified: Complete frame/pixel identity from metadata alone

mcp_minimum_contract.operation: Fixed bounded DERBY observation, no caller-provided keys, no automatic retries
mcp_minimum_contract.request: Existing exact build/flash binding; fixed duration/race/frame ceiling
mcp_minimum_contract.response: Principal-bound job report with broker epoch, build/flash receipt, device fingerprint, ordered device counters and bounded allowlisted DERBY scene/camera/error events. Include gap/truncation/refusal/limit flags.
mcp_minimum_contract.images: Fixed count of consecutive images with capture start/end, current observed run/race/seed/phase/camera/frame context and any changes during capture. Metadata does not attest pixel coherence.
mcp_minimum_contract.oracle: Exact controlled draw-input comparison additionally requires complete projection/lane/camera history or actual submitted draw inputs; the TLM line alone is insufficient.

host_commands: node tools/games/export_derby_oracle.mjs oracle.json (clean committed checkout required)
next_flash: Separate commit and PR with same-head CI for OFF/ON builds plus host regressions and independent review. Reuse successful PR7/LKG until explicit normal device ownership and formal recovery/flash/readback/boot checks pass.
